name: Nonosaka Mao
source:
One of Yukiteru's friends at his new school. Mao is a very gentle, polite and perky girl, using honorifics towards most people she knows. Her best friend is Hinata, whom she loves deeply and is very protective of. She displays her affection very openly and is willing to do anything for Hinata.

[From [url=http://futurediary.wikia.com/wiki/Mao_Nonosaka]Mirai Nikki Wiki[/url]]
